facts.fact: Angola's INE published the Anuario de Estatisticas Sociais covering 2017-2022 (demography, education, health, employment, culture, gender, social action, energy, water), saying administrative-information coverage is still deficient and prevents calculating many indicators; the page gives no year, 2024 is inferred, and it names no record-holding body.

AGO.note: Social statistics yearbook; no census or household survey stated.
